title: 第47章：断桥，烂泥滩，以及水下的阴影
slug: 丧尸爆发我的房车能无限升级
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

房车驶离工业区四公里后，空气才开始回暖。仪表盘上的外部温度读数从十度缓慢爬升到十九度，车载除霜系统自动关闭。之前穿过那片吸热菌丝区域时，车窗边缘结了一层薄冰，现在正化成水珠往下淌。

周建国把方向盘抓得死紧，手指关节位置发白，倒不是怕，是刚才十分钟的紧张还没散干净。他松开一只手在裤子上蹭了蹭汗，又抓回去。刘刚从车顶观察塔爬下来，把望远镜搁在操控台上，端起自己的搪瓷缸子灌了一大口凉水，喉结大幅度上下滚动。

“那堆白毛会不会追上来？”

张教授没抬头，盯着数据板上的读数。菌丝网络的能量信号在显示屏上趋于平稳，稳定在一个不低的值上，但没有往外扩散的趋势。他把数据板转了半圈，推到林昊面前。

“它在原地蓄能。这个增长速率，再给它三天，边界线就困不住它了。不过三天后灰烬协议的轰炸先到，到时候不管它多能吸热，云爆弹的高温高压下活不了。”

赖文斌的通讯从后车接进来，声音被引擎声压得有些发闷：“林队，我的人刚才清点了物资损耗。穿过那片工业区的时候，卡车的油箱漏了一截。不是物理损伤，是橡胶油管被吸走了热量，老化开裂。临时抢修了一下，但漏掉的柴油回不来。”

“还能跑多远？”

“按现在的油耗，撑不到中转站。差二十公里左右。”

林昊在导航上拉了一下路线。中转站在东南方向四十九公里，沿途标记了两个废弃加油站。第一个在十二公里外，系统地图上标注的是“结构完整，油料状态未知”。第二个在三十六公里处，紧挨着一座小型水泥厂。

“第一个加油站停车，抽油。”

赖文斌回了个“收到”，通讯挂断。

车厢后方，陈叔坐在折叠椅上，把箭壶里的箭一支支抽出来检查。复合弓的弓弦在之前的颠簸中稍微松了一点，他用扳手拧紧调节螺丝，拇指拨了一下弦，嗡一声闷响，振动频率让他点了点头。

苏晴从医疗区探出头：“前面停车的话，陈雪薇需要下车透口气。车里闷太久了，伤口虽然没感染，但血液循环不好，腿有点浮肿。”

“十分钟。”

赵铁柱靠在车门边，武士刀已经收回鞘里，他用一小块油布反复擦拭刀柄上的防滑缠绳。刀柄末端那个豁口还在，是之前砍Omega骨甲时崩掉的，他没修。

“你说那个菌丝网络，算不算变异体的一种？”

张教授从数据板上抬起眼：“严格来说，算。但不是动物性变异。目前GX-17的已知感染路径是动物细胞融合。植物和真菌的细胞壁结构不同，理论上不会被感染。工业区那个，更有可能是基因编辑产物。”

“创世纪？”

“或者比创世纪更早的东西。楚河说过，枫林镇地下那些实验，只是GX-17整体研发计划的一部分。核心母体Omega是从别处运过来的。如果Omega都能运过来，别的试验品散布到周边并不奇怪。”

对话被前方的路况打断。公路裂成两截，中间横着一条宽约五米的裂缝，深度看不清，底下有水流声。裂缝两侧的沥青路面翘起，露出下面褐红色的土层。不是地震造成的，裂缝边缘有规则的铲挖痕迹。

“人工挖断的。”周建国把车刹停，探身往前看了看，“这宽度，卡车过不去。”

赵铁柱跳下车，走到裂缝边缘往下看了一眼。水流很急，颜色泛白，带着泥沙。对岸有辆翻倒的铲车，驾驶室空了，操纵杆上生了厚厚一层铁锈。铲车的铲斗还嵌在裂缝边缘的土里。

“有人故意挖断公路，为了拦什么东西。”赵铁柱回头冲车厢方向说。

林昊下车，走到裂缝边。系统地图上这条路原本是通的，挖断的时间应该不长，不超过两天。他沿着裂缝往两侧看，东西方向各延伸出去的土堆形成一道松散的土墙，配合几辆横七竖八的废弃车辆，构成简易的防御工事。

工事后方，有烟。

是炊烟。从一个废弃的加油站后面升起来的，很细，贴着地面飘，不注意看会被当成扬尘。

裂缝对岸的碎砖堆后头，有个脑袋探出来，又缩回去了。隔了大概十秒，一个干瘦的男人从砖堆后面站起来，手里攥着一根磨尖的钢筋，钢筋头上还焊着几个生锈的钉子。他看着林昊这边的车队，没说话，也没躲。

“桥断了。”那男人最终开口，声音哑得厉害，每个字都像从砂纸上搓过去。

“看出来了。”林昊没往前走，隔着裂缝喊话，“谁挖的？”

“我们。”男人把钢筋杵在地上，靠在上头歇了口气，“前头水泥厂里有东西。挖断路，它过不来。”

“什么样的东西？”

男人没回答。他从口袋里摸出半截烟屁股，没点，就叼在嘴里嚼着。过了片刻，往后一指加油站的方向：“你们要是想绕路，从东边河滩能过去，得趟水。要抽油的话，加油站地下罐子还有大半箱柴油。我们没动，用不上。”

Page (1/3)

After the RV drove four kilometers away from the industrial area, the air began to warm up.The outside temperature reading on the dashboard slowly climbed from ten degrees to nineteen degrees, and the on-board defrost system shut down automatically.When I passed through the area of ​​heat-absorbing mycelium, a thin layer of ice formed on the edge of the car window, and now it turned into water droplets and dripped down.

Zhou Jianguo gripped the steering wheel so tightly that his finger joints turned white. It was not because he was afraid, but because the tension of the past ten minutes had not completely dissipated.He let go of one hand and wiped the sweat on his pants, then grabbed it back.Liu Gang climbed down from the observation tower on the roof of the car, placed the telescope on the console, picked up his enamel jar and took a big gulp of cold water, his Adam's apple rolling up and down.

"Will those piles of white hair catch up?"

Professor Zhang did not raise his head, staring at the readings on the data board.The energy signal of the mycelium network stabilizes on the display screen, stabilizing at a not low value, but has no tendency to spread outward.He turned the data tablet half a circle and pushed it in front of Lin Hao.

"It accumulates energy in place. At this growth rate, if you give it another three days, the border line will not be able to trap it. However, the bombing of the Ashes Agreement will arrive first in three days. By then, no matter how much heat it can absorb, it will not be able to survive the high temperature and pressure of the cloud bomb."

Lai Wenbin's communication came in from the rear car, his voice muffled by the sound of the engine: "Team Lin, my people have just counted the material losses. When passing through the industrial area, the truck's fuel tank leaked a section. It is not a physical damage, but the rubber oil pipe has absorbed the heat and aged and cracked. We did a temporary repair, but the leaked diesel oil cannot be recovered."

"How far can you run?"

"Based on the current fuel consumption, we can't make it to the transfer station. It's about 20 kilometers away."

Lin Hao pulled the route on the navigation screen.The transfer station is forty-nine kilometers southeast, with two abandoned gas stations marked along the way.The first one is twelve kilometers away, and it is marked on the system map as "Structurally intact, fuel status unknown."The second one is thirty-six kilometers away, next to a small cement factory.

"Stop at the first gas station and pump gas."

Lai Wenbin replied "received" and the communication was hung up.

At the back of the carriage, Uncle Chen sat on a folding chair and took out the arrows in the arrow pot one by one to check.The bowstring of the compound bow was slightly loosened by the previous bumps. He tightened the adjustment screw with a wrench and plucked the string with his thumb. There was a muffled buzz, and the vibration frequency made him nod.

Su Qing poked her head out from the medical area: "If you park in front, Chen Xuewei needs to get out of the car and take a breath. The car has been stuffy for too long. Although the wound is not infected, the blood circulation is not good and the legs are a bit swollen."

"Ten minutes."

Zhao Tiezhu leaned against the car door. The samurai sword had been retracted into its sheath. He repeatedly wiped the non-slip rope on the handle with a small piece of oil cloth.The gap at the end of the knife's handle was still there. It was broken when he cut the Omega's bone armor before, but he didn't repair it.

"Do you think that mycelial network is a type of mutant?"

Professor Zhang raised his eyes from the data board: "Strictly speaking, it counts. But it is not an animal mutation. The currently known infection route of GX-17 is the fusion of animal cells. Plants and fungi have different cell wall structures and theoretically cannot be infected. The one in the industrial area is more likely to be the product of gene editing."

"Genesis?"

"Or something earlier than Genesis. Chu He said that the experiments underground in Maplewood Town were only part of the overall GX-17 research and development plan. The core matrix Omega was transported from elsewhere. If Omega can be transported here, it is not surprising that other experimental products are scattered around."

The conversation was interrupted by the traffic ahead.The road split into two parts, with a crack about five meters wide in the middle. The depth could not be seen clearly, and there was the sound of water flowing underneath.The asphalt pavement on both sides of the crack lifted up, revealing the brown-red soil underneath.It was not caused by an earthquake. There were regular shoveling marks on the edges of the cracks.

"It was dug manually." Zhou Jianguo stopped the car, leaned forward and looked forward, "This width cannot be passed by a truck."

Zhao Tiezhu jumped out of the car, walked to the edge of the crack and took a look down.The water flow is very fast, white in color, and carries silt.There was an overturned forklift on the other side. The cab was empty and there was a thick layer of rust on the control lever.The bucket of the forklift was still embedded in the soil at the edge of the crack.

"Someone dug up the road deliberately to block something." Zhao Tiezhu turned around and said in the direction of the carriage.

Lin Hao got out of the car and walked to the crack.This road was originally open on the system map, and the digging time should not be long, no more than two days.He looked along the crack to both sides. The mounds of soil extending in the east and west directions formed a loose earth wall. Together with a few abandoned vehicles scattered across the crack, they formed a simple fortification.

Behind the fortifications, there was smoke.

It's cooking smoke.It rises from behind an abandoned gas station. It is very thin and floats close to the ground. If you don't pay attention, it will be regarded as dust.

Behind the pile of broken bricks on the other side of the crack, a head poked out, then retracted.After about ten seconds, a skinny man stood up from behind the pile of bricks, holding a sharpened steel bar in his hand with a few rusty nails welded to the head.He looked at Lin Hao's motorcade without saying anything or hiding.

"The bridge is broken." The man finally spoke, his voice hoarse, and every word seemed to have been rubbed out from sandpaper.

"I can see it." Lin Hao didn't move forward and shouted through the crack, "Who dug it?"

"We." The man punched the steel bars on the ground and leaned on them to take a breath. "There is something in the cement factory ahead. Dig the road and it won't be able to get through."

"What kind of thing?"

The man didn't answer.He took out half of the cigarette butt from his pocket, held it in his mouth and chewed it without lighting it.After a while, he pointed back in the direction of the gas station: "If you want to take a detour, you can get there from the east river beach, and you have to wade through the water. If you want to pump gas, there is still more than half a tank of diesel in the underground tank of the gas station. We haven't moved it, so we can't use it."
